error_made_and_corrected_in_this_card.root_cause: criterion/object form mismatch. The initial substring pattern `oracle\.md[^"]{0,80}pre-run frozen` matched two kinds of text that are not assertions: (a) the boundary conditional 'if the owner wants oracle.md treated as pre-run frozen evidence, this attempt is NOT sufficient'; (b) the explicit denial 'oracle.md is NOT described anywhere in this attempt as pre-run frozen'.
error_made_and_corrected_in_this_card.fix: require a POSITIVE and UNQUALIFIED assertion: exclude matches whose window contains an 'if ... want(s)' conditional or a NOT/never/is-not negation.
error_made_and_corrected_in_this_card.significance: the 10th instance of this project's same-class lesson (cf. I-10-B's terminal-value criterion, T1-6's prefix/suffix criterion for a composite edit, task_plan.md Round 44's pure-insertion criterion for an in-line append): the criterion must match the form of the object being judged. A criterion that cannot tell asserting from conditioning or denying reports a violation that does not exist -- as harmful as missing one.
